name: Gemini Vibe Coding Prompts 😎 💖
description_md:
## What You Get

- 
Ready-to-use initial prompt optimized specifically for Gemini 2.5 Pro, ensuring precision and reducing guesswork.

- 
Step-by-step instructions on turning a simple Loom screen recording into a perfect, fully-formed Gemini prompt.

- 
Real-world use case example demonstrating how to transform inspiration from existing apps into customized solutions on platforms like Lovable.dev, Bolt, and Firebase Studio.

- 
Prompts used for web apps designed in the video including detailed layout, UI/UX strategies, key feature breakdowns, and visual styling suggestions tailored for Lovable.dev implementation.
